support.faq1q: How can I add a place to favorites?
support.faq1a: To add a place to favorites, simply tap the heart icon in the upper right corner of the business page. The place will appear in your "My favorites" section.
support.faq2q: How do I write a review?
support.faq2a: Go to the business page, scroll down to the reviews section and press the "Write a review" button. Select your rating, write your comment and optionally add photos.
support.faq3q: Can I edit or delete my review?
support.faq3a: Yes, go to your profile > My reviews. Tap the three dots on your review and select "Edit" or "Delete".
support.faq4q: How do I change my profile photo?
support.faq4a: Go to your profile, tap your current photo and select "Change photo". You can take a new photo or choose one from your gallery.
support.faq5q: How do I turn off notifications?
support.faq5a: Go to your profile > Settings > Notifications. From there you can customize what type of notifications you want to receive.
support.faq6q: Can businesses respond to my reviews?
support.faq6a: Yes, business owners can respond to reviews. You will receive a notification when they respond to your review.
support.faq7q: How do I report inappropriate content?
support.faq7a: You can report reviews or inappropriate content by tapping the three dots icon and selecting "Report". Our team will review the report.
support.faq8a: Yes, go to Profile > Settings > Privacy and security > Delete my account. Please note that this action is permanent.
